div.div: From the developers.archieapp.co API reference. Everything bookable is an Area with a category (floor, conference-room, event-space, parking, table, chair and others), nested under a location Space. Areas carry typed map, map_meta and origin fields, and Update Area (PUT) accepts them. The nesting order and the User fields are inferred.

switch.text: From the developers.archieapp.co API reference. Everything bookable is an Area with a category (floor, conference-room, event-space, parking, table, chair and others), nested under a location Space. Areas carry typed map, map_meta and origin fields, and Update Area (PUT) accepts them. The nesting order and the User fields are inferred.
